privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How we handle personal data when you visit this site or contact us.
privacy.questions: Questions about this policy? Get in touch:

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Lotus Craft (business ID 3583247-2), Helsinginkatu 11 / Kustaankatu 1, 00500 Helsinki, is the data controller for this website. Questions: +358 40 681 2264 or lotuscraft.fin@gmail.com.
We have not appointed a data protection officer, and given the scale of our operations one is not required. Requests about your personal data should be sent to the contact details above.

sections.heading: What data we process
paragraphs: The contact form processes the following:
bullets: your name and email address
your phone number, if you provide one
the content of your message
whether you write as an individual or a business, plus your company name and industry if you choose business
the service you select and how you would like us to contact you

sections.heading: Giving your data is voluntary
paragraphs: You are not obliged to provide your details. Without them, however, we cannot answer your enquiry or give you a quote.
We do not ask for, and do not accept, special categories of data such as information about health, religion or your personal identity code. Please do not send any in the form.

sections.heading: How data is collected, and what happens automatically
bullets: We receive the data directly from you through the contact form.
The site sets one cookie only, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers your language choice. It lasts for the browsing session and is removed when you close the browser.
To guard against abuse we hold the request's IP address temporarily in server memory. We do not store it and we do not write it to log files.

Our server logs contain technical facts only, such as whether a submission succeeded or was rejected and the length of the message. We do not log names, email addresses, phone numbers or message content.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis
bullets: Consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR): we receive and handle your enquiry after you tick the consent box on the form.
Performance of a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR): if your enquiry leads to an order or a service agreement, we process your details to carry it out.
Legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR): we prevent automated abuse and keep the site secure.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
paragraphs: Your message stays in our mailbox for as long as it takes to answer the enquiry and to serve you as a customer if that follows.
If an enquiry produces an accounting document, we keep the necessary details for six years as the Finnish Accounting Act requires.
We do not maintain a separate customer register, and we neither sell nor share your details for marketing.

sections.heading: Who receives the data
paragraphs: We process your data ourselves. The only services that take part are:
bullets: Google (Gmail): enquiry messages are sent over SMTP to our Gmail mailbox, so the content of a message passes through and is stored in Google's services.
Vercel Inc.: the website and its server-side logic run on Vercel's platform, which also enforces the limit on automated submissions.

sections.heading: Tracking and third parties
bullets: We use no advertising cookies, no analytics or advertising services, no tracking pixels and no social media plugins.
The Inter font used by the site is hosted on our own server, so your browser never requests fonts from Google Fonts.
Our external links (Instagram, Google Maps and the data protection authority at tietosuoja.fi) are ordinary hyperlinks. No data reaches those services unless you click through to them.

sections.heading: Transfers outside the EU and EEA
paragraphs: Google and Vercel may process data outside the European Union or the EEA, for example in the United States. Where they do, the transfer relies on Chapter V of the GDPR: the providers typically use the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certification or the EU standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
bullets: check whether we process your personal data and obtain a copy of it
have inaccurate data corrected and incomplete data completed
have data erased where it is no longer needed for the purpose it was collected for
obtain restriction of processing, or object to processing
receive the data you gave us in a structured, machine-readable format and transfer it elsewhere, where processing is based on consent and carried out automatically
withdraw your consent at any time; withdrawing it does not affect the lawfulness of processing before the withdrawal

sections.heading: How to exercise your rights
paragraphs: Contact us using the phone number or email address above. Making a request is free of charge and we will answer within one month of receiving it. We may ask you to verify your identity so that we disclose data only to the right person.

sections.heading: Supervisory authority
paragraphs: If you believe we process your personal data unlawfully, you may lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority: the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto), Finland. More information at https://tietosuoja.fi

sections.heading: Automated decision-making and profiling
paragraphs: We do not make automated decisions and we do not profile visitors to this site.

sections.heading: Children's data
paragraphs: Our services are not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16. If we become aware that we have, we delete it.

sections.heading: Security
bullets: Traffic to and from the site is encrypted with HTTPS.
We strip control characters from what you type and render submitted content safely, so form input cannot execute code.
The contact form checks a single-use signed token that confirms the form was loaded from this site.
We limit how many messages can be sent automatically.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We update this policy when our services or the law change. The version in force is always the content of this page, and its effective date appears at the top.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The Lotus Craft Story
about.story_p1: Lotus Craft was born from a passion for the art of sewing and a commitment to providing exceptional garment and textile care in Helsinki. From expert alterations to professional rug washing and dry cleaning, we believe that every piece deserves the finest treatment.
about.story_p2: Located in the vibrant Kallio district, our workshop is where traditional craftsmanship meets modern techniques. Whether it's a beloved vintage dress that needs mending, a brand-new suit that needs the perfect fit, or a precious Persian rug that needs a professional wash — we treat every item with the same care and attention.
about.story_p3: Our team of skilled artisans brings years of experience and a genuine love for what they do. From the first consultation to the final stitch or the freshly cleaned rug returned to your door, we're dedicated to exceeding your expectations.
about.mission: To provide our customers with the best possible garment and textile care by combining traditional craftsmanship with modern expertise. We aim to make every alteration seamless, every cleaning impeccable, and every customer truly satisfied.

korjausompelu.h1: Clothing Alterations and Repairs in Helsinki
korjausompelu.intro: We hem trousers and skirts, taper waists and legs, mend pockets and replace zippers. Every job is done in our own workshop in Kallio, Helsinki.
korjausompelu.intro2: We also take custom orders: women's and girls' clothing, pillowcases, bedspreads and curtains.
korjausompelu.turnaround: Alterations and repairs are usually ready in 2–3 days. Custom-made garments normally take 2–3 weeks.

mattopesu.intro: We wash rugs according to their material, from thin cotton and rag rugs to hand-knotted silk. The price is always per square metre, so even a large rug is easy to estimate.
mattopesu.intro2: We handle Finnish ryijy rugs, Persian rugs, jute and sisal, as well as fur and hide rugs.
mattopesu.turnaround: Washing and drying usually takes 7–10 days.
mattopesu.delivery: Rug pickup and delivery is available. Contact us to arrange a time.

kuivapesu.h1: Dry Cleaning in Helsinki – Suits, Coats and Outdoor Wear
kuivapesu.intro: Suits, shirts, coats and outdoor wear are cleaned the way each material requires. The most delicate silk and formal garments are handled as their own group.
kuivapesu.intro2: We also handle demanding brands and materials: Canada Goose jackets, Gore-Tex garments and ski wear.
kuivapesu.delivery: Pickup and delivery is available. Contact us to arrange a time.

hotellipesula.h1: Contract Laundry for Hotels and Businesses in Helsinki
hotellipesula.intro: We provide contract-based washing for hotels, hostels and motels, as well as restaurants, spas and healthcare businesses. We wash bed linen, towels, pillowcases, blankets, curtains and every kind of rug.
hotellipesula.intro2: Request a quote through the contact form by choosing Business as your inquiry type.
hotellipesula.delivery: Contract customers get pickup and delivery as part of the service.

faq.korjausompelu_q1: How much does trouser hemming cost?
faq.korjausompelu_a1: Shortening with the original hem starts at €25. Leather trouser shortening starts at €30, as does a side seam adjustment.
faq.korjausompelu_q2: Do you replace a jacket zipper?
faq.korjausompelu_a2: Yes. A jacket zipper starts at €45, a long jacket at €55, leather at €65 and a down jacket at €48.
faq.korjausompelu_q3: Do you alter wedding and evening dresses?
faq.korjausompelu_a3: Yes. Evening and wedding dress repair starts at €80 and evening gown tailoring at €100. Cleaning is a separate service: a wedding dress is €110–155.
faq.mattopesu_q1: How is the rug washing price calculated?
faq.mattopesu_a1: The price is per square metre: €16/m² for thin rugs, €19/m² for thick and Persian rugs, and €31/m² for wool, ryijy and silk rugs.
faq.mattopesu_q2: What does a 3 × 2 metre rug cost to wash?
faq.mattopesu_a2: That is 6 square metres, so a thin rug comes to 6 × €16 = €96 and a wool or ryijy rug to 6 × €31 = €186. The final price can rise with the material and condition.
faq.mattopesu_q3: Do you wash Persian or hand-knotted rugs?
faq.mattopesu_a3: Yes. Persian rugs fall in the €19/m² group, while hand-knotted and fine wool and silk rugs, fur rugs and ryijys fall in the €31/m² group.
faq.kuivapesu_q1: How much does suit dry cleaning cost?
faq.kuivapesu_a1: A suit is €42, a blazer €24, trousers €20 and a shirt €10. A package of six shirts is €48.
faq.kuivapesu_q2: Do you clean Canada Goose or Gore-Tex?
faq.kuivapesu_a2: Yes. Premium brand jackets such as Canada Goose are €58–68, Gore-Tex clothing €40 and a down jacket €38–44.
faq.kuivapesu_q3: What does wedding or silk dress cleaning cost?
faq.kuivapesu_a3: A wedding dress is €110–155, a long evening gown €55–78, a silk dress €45–60 and a silk suit €55. A christening gown is €28.
faq.hotellipesula_q1: How do we set up a laundry contract?
faq.hotellipesula_a1: Fill in the contact form and choose Business as your inquiry type. Tell us your industry and the service you need, and we will get back to you.
faq.hotellipesula_q2: What does business sheet washing cost?
faq.hotellipesula_a2: Sheets are €7.50 per kg for loads over 5 kg. Curtains are €25 and lined curtains €48.
faq.hotellipesula_q3: Do you wash hotel carpets and rugs?
faq.hotellipesula_a3: Yes. Rugs are washed at €16–31 per square metre depending on the rug type.
